svg.text: P1/P2 expansion headers – project-committed connections highlighted – see pb1/pinout-reference.md for the full pinmux table
SPI1 – APA102 pixel strip (OLA SPI plugin)
eQEP0 – rotary encoder A/B + its push button
power pins (colored by voltage, not just "is power"):
connected to the header above only via matching pin labels, not a drawn wire – power pins included for soldering
strip's own 5V + GND injected from an
external supply, not PB1's VOUT-5V – that
pin is logic-only, not rated for LED
